name: Daifuku
source:
A member of the White Mouse Clan serving [url=/c87444]Tsukuyomi[/url].
The eldest of the three mouse siblings, [url=/c87713]Paris'[/url] and [url=/c87714]Juliette's[/url] older brother.
While he was wandering on the surface, he met his current owner, [url=/c74512]Olympia[/url].
He loves eating and is particularly fond of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daifuku]daifukumochi[/url].
[Spoiler]His original name is "Romeo".[/spoiler]
